claim: The employment contract must be written, authenticated by the Ministry of Labour's department and made in three copies, one for each party and one deposited with the department.
quote: The Employment Contract must be written and authenticated by the Department / Directorate, and prepared in three copies, with each party receiving a copy, and the third being deposited with the Department / Directorate.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date.

claim: A contract may include a probation period of at most six months from the start of work, and only once with the same employer.
quote: provided that it does not exceed six months from the date of commencing work. The Employee / Worker may not be placed under probation more than once with the same Employer.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date.

claim: During probation the employer must give at least one month's notice to end the contract if the worker is unsuitable.
quote: provided that the Employee / Worker is notified of this, at least one month before the date of Contract Termination
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date.

claim: A worker on probation who wants to move to another employer must give the current employer one month's written notice; the new employer compensates the current employer for the ticket and recruitment fees, up to two months' basic salary.
quote: they must notify the current Employer in writing of their desire to terminate the Contract at least one month before the date of Contract Termination, and the new Employer is obliged to provide Compensation / Indemnity to the current Employer for the value of the ticket and recruitment fees, if any, provided that the Compensation / Indemnity does not exceed the Basic Salary of the Employee / Worker for two months.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date.

claim: A worker on probation who wants to end the contract and leave Qatar must give written notice as agreed, at most two months; a migrant who leaves without following these rules may not get a work permit for one year from departure.
quote: if the expatriate Employee / Worker leaves the country without complying with the provisions stipulated in this article, they may not be granted a work permit for one year from the date of departure.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date.

claim: After probation, either side may end the contract with written notice: one month during the first and second years of work.
quote: خلال السنة الأولى والثانية من العمل، تكون مدة الإخطار شهرا.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 49 (Arabic).

claim: After the second year of work, the notice period is two months.
quote: بعد السنة الثانية من العمل، تكون مدة الإخطار شهرين.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 49 (Arabic).

claim: A side that ends the contract without giving the notice pays the other side the worker's basic wage for the notice period or the part not given.
quote: ألزم من أنهى العقد بأن يؤدي إلى الطرف الآخر تعويضاً مساوياً للأجر الأساسي للعامل عن مدة الإخطار أو المدة المتبقية منها.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 49 (Arabic).

claim: A migrant worker who leaves Qatar without following the notice rules may not get a work permit for one year from departure (after probation too).
quote: وفي جميع الأحوال، إذا غادر العامل الوافد البلاد دون التقيد بالأحكام المنصوص عليها في هذه المادة، فلا يجوز منحه ترخيصاً بالعمل لمدة سنة اعتباراً من تاريخ المغادرة.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 49 (Arabic).

claim: A worker may end the contract without notice and keep the full end-of-service gratuity if the employer breaches the contract or the law, assaults the worker or family, deceived the worker about the terms, leaves a known serious danger, or a dispute committee rules finally for the worker.
quote: مع احتفاظه بحقه كاملاً في مكافأة نهاية الخدمة، في أي من الحالات التالية: 1- إذا أخل صاحب العمل بالتزاماته المقررة بموجب عقد العمل أو بموجب أحكام هذا القانون.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 51 (Arabic, as amended).

claim: One of the grounds is a final decision of a Labour Dispute Settlement Committee in the worker's favour.
quote: إذا صدر قرار نهائي من إحدى لجان فض المنازعات العمالية لصالح العامل.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 51 item 5 (Arabic).

claim: At the end of the contract the employer must give the worker, free on request, a service certificate (dates, job, wage) and return the certificates and documents the worker deposited.
quote: يمنح العامل، بناءً على طلبه، دون مقابل شهادة خدمة
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 53 (Arabic).

claim: A worker with one full year or more of service gets an end-of-service gratuity of at least three weeks' wage per year of service, with part years counted pro rata.
quote: بشرط ألا تقل عن أجر ثلاثة أسابيع عن كل سنة من سنوات الخدمة، ويستحق العامل المكافأة عن كسور السنة بنسبة المدة التي قضاها في الخدمة.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 54 (Arabic).

claim: The gratuity is calculated on the worker's last basic wage, and the employer may deduct amounts the worker owes it.
quote: ويتخذ الأجر الأساسي الأخير للعامل أساساً لحساب المكافأة المشار إليها. ويحق لصاحب العمل أن يخصم من المكافأة المبالغ التي يدين له بها العامل.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 54 (Arabic).

claim: If a worker dies in service, the employer must deposit all wages, other dues and the gratuity with the competent court within 15 days of the death; the court distributes them to the heirs under Islamic law or the personal status law of the worker's country.
quote: وجب على صاحب العمل أن يودع خزينة المحكمة المختصة خلال مدة لا تزيد على خمسة عشر يوماً من تاريخ الوفاة أي أجر، أو مستحقات أخرى للعامل مضافاً إليها مكافأة نهاية الخدمة
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 55 (Arabic).

claim: At the end of service the employer must send the worker back, at its own cost, to the place it recruited the worker from, and finish the return procedures within two weeks of the contract ending; if the worker takes another job before leaving, the new employer takes over this duty.
quote: عند انتهاء خدمة العامل، يجب على صاحب العمل أن يعيده على نفقته إلى المكان الذي استقدمه منه وقت التحاقه بالعمل لديه
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 57 (Arabic).

claim: The employer must finish the return procedures of a non-Qatari worker within two weeks of the contract ending.
quote: ويجب على صاحب العمل إنهاء إجراءات إعادة العامل غير القطري خلال مدة لا تجاوز أسبوعين من تاريخ انتهاء العقد
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 57 (Arabic).

claim: The employer pays to prepare and transport a dead worker's body home if the family asks; if it does not, the Ministry does it at the employer's cost.
quote: ويتحمل صاحب العمل تكاليف تجهيز ونقل جثمان العامل المتوفى إلى موطنه الأصلي أو محل إقامته إذا طلب ذويه ذلك.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 57 (Arabic).

claim: Wages are paid in Qatari riyals, at least once a month for monthly-paid workers, by transfer to the worker's account at a financial institution in Qatar; the employer is not cleared of the wage any other way.
quote: ويجب على صاحب العمل تحويل الأجر إلى حساب العامل في إحدى المؤسسات المالية بالدولة
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 66 (Arabic, as amended).

claim: When a contract ends, the employer must pay the wage and all dues before the end of the next working day (within 7 days if the worker left without notice).
quote: وجب على صاحب العمل أداء أجر العامل وجميع المبالغ المستحقة له قبل نهاية يوم العمل التالي لليوم الذي ينتهي فيه العقد
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 67 (Arabic).

claim: The employer may not charge interest on loans to a worker or deduct more than 10% of the wage to repay them, and total deductions may not exceed 50% of the wage.
quote: ولا يجوز لصاحب العمل أن يتقاضى أية فائدة على ما يقرضه للعامل، كما لا يجوز له أن يقتطع من أجر العامل أكثر من (10%) وفاءً لما يكون قد أقرضه له من المال.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 70 (Arabic).

claim: Total deductions from a worker's wage may not exceed 50% of the wage.
quote: ولا يجوز أن يزيد مجموع ما يقتطع من أجر العامل وفاءً للخصومات والديون المترتبة في ذمته على (50%) من مجموع أجره.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 70 (Arabic).

claim: A worker cannot be forced to buy food or goods from particular shops or from the employer.
quote: لا يجوز إلزام العامل بشراء أغذية أو سلع من محال معينة أو من إنتاج صاحب العمل.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 69 (Arabic).

claim: Normal working hours are at most 48 a week, 8 a day.
quote: يكون الحد الأقصى لساعات العمل العادية، ثمان وأربعين ساعة في الأسبوع وبواقع ثماني ساعات يومياً
value: 48 a week, 8 a day; Ramadan 36 a week, 6 a day
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 73 (Arabic).

claim: In Ramadan normal hours are at most 36 a week, 6 a day; travel between home and work does not count as working time.
quote: فيكون ست وثلاثين ساعة في الأسبوع بواقع ست ساعات يومياً. ولا يحسب ضمن ساعات العمل الوقت الذي يقضيه العامل في الانتقال بين مكان سكنه ومكان العمل.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 73 (Arabic).

claim: Working hours must include one or more breaks for prayer, rest and food of 1 to 3 hours in total, so that no one works more than 5 hours in a row.
quote: ويراعى في تحديد فترة أو فترات الراحة، ألا يشتغل العامل أكثر من خمس ساعات متتالية.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 73 (Arabic).

claim: Overtime is allowed, but total actual work may not exceed 10 hours a day except to prevent serious loss or accident.
quote: على ألا يزيد مجموع ساعات العمل الفعلية في اليوم الواحد على عشر ساعات
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 74 (Arabic).

claim: Overtime is paid at the basic wage plus at least 25%.
quote: ما لا يقل عن الأجر الأساسي المستحق عن ساعات العمل العادية، مضافاً إليه زيادة لا تقل عن (25%) من هذا الأجر.
value: basic wage +25%; 9 pm-3 am +50% (not shift workers); rest day +150%
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 74 (Arabic).

claim: Work between 9 pm and 3 am is paid at the basic wage plus at least 50%, except for shift workers.
quote: كما يدفع للعمال الذين يعملون بين الساعة التاسعة مساءً والثالثة صباحاً الأجر الأساسي المستحق عن ساعات العمل العادية مضافاً إليه زيادة لا تقل عن (50%) من ذلك الأجر وذلك فيما عدا عمال المناوبة.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 74 (Arabic).

claim: Workers get a paid weekly rest of at least 24 hours in a row, normally Friday.
quote: يمنح العامل راحة أسبوعية مدفوعة الأجر، لا تقل عن أربع وعشرين ساعة متتالية، ويوم الجمعة هو يوم الراحة الأسبوعية العادي لجميع العمال فيما عدا عمال المناوبة
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 75 (Arabic).

claim: A worker made to work on the rest day gets another rest day and the normal rest-day pay, or the basic wage plus at least 150%; no one (except shift workers) may work more than two Fridays in a row.
quote: أو يدفع له أجره الأساسي المستحق له مضافاً إليه زيادة تعادل (150%) من أجره على الأقل. وفيما عدا عمال المناوبة، لا يجوز تشغيل العامل أكثر من يومي جمعة متتاليين.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 75 (Arabic).

claim: Workers get paid holidays of 3 working days for Eid al-Fitr, 3 for Eid al-Adha, 1 for the national day and 3 days chosen by the employer.
quote: 1- ثلاثة أيام عمل بمناسبة عيد الفطر. 2- ثلاثة أيام عمل بمناسبة عيد الأضحى.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 78 (Arabic).

claim: Law 9 of 2026 replaced item 3 of Article 78: one paid working day for the State's National Day.
quote: One working day on the occasion of the National Day of the State.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official).

claim: After one full year of service, annual paid leave is at least 3 weeks for under 5 years' service and 4 weeks for 5 years or more, with part years pro rata.
quote: ويجب ألا تقل هذه الإجازة عن ثلاثة أسابيع للعامل الذي تقل خدمته عن خمس سنوات، وأربعة أسابيع للعامل الذي تكون مدة خدمته خمس سنوات فأكثر.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 79 (Arabic).

claim: Before annual leave the employer must pay the wage earned up to the leave plus the leave pay.
quote: على صاحب العمل أن يدفع للعامل قبل قيامه بالإجازة السنوية الأجر المستحق له لقاء العمل الذي أداه حتى تاريخ القيام بالإجازة، مضافاً إليه أجر الإجازة المستحق له.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 68 (Arabic).

claim: A worker cannot give up annual leave, and is paid cash for leave not taken when the contract ends.
quote: The employee is entitled to receive a cash compensation equal to his wage for the days of Annual Leave due to him if the employment contract ends for any reason before he has taken it.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 81.

claim: Paid sick leave starts after three months of service and needs a certificate from a doctor approved by the employer.
quote: This leave is not granted until three months have passed from the date he first joins the work, and provided his illness is proven by a certificate from a doctor approved by the Employer.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 82.

claim: Sick leave is on full pay for up to two weeks, then half pay for four more weeks, then unpaid; the employer may end the contract after 12 weeks if a specialist says the worker cannot return.
quote: The Employee / Worker receives his full wage if the Sick Leave does not exceed two weeks; if it extends beyond that, he is granted half his wage for another four weeks.
value: after 3 months' service: 2 weeks full pay, 4 weeks half pay, then unpaid
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 82.

claim: A Muslim worker can take unpaid special leave of up to 20 days once during service for Hajj.
quote: يمنح العامل المسلم إجازة خاصة بدون أجر لا تزيد على عشرين يوماً لأداء فريضة الحج لمرة واحدة أثناء مدة خدمته.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 83 (Arabic).

claim: The employer may not end the contract, or give notice of ending it, during any leave.
quote: The employer may not terminate the labour Contract or notify the Employee / Worker of its termination during any of the leaves stipulated in this Law / Act.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 85.

claim: The employer may dismiss a worker without notice or gratuity for being absent without good reason for more than 7 days in a row or 15 days in total in a year.
quote: إذا تغيب العامل عن العمل بدون سبب مشروع أكثر من سبعة أيام متصلة أو خمسة عشر يوماً متقطعة خلال السنة.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 61 item 9 (Arabic).

claim: Being clearly drunk or under the influence of drugs during working hours is a ground for dismissal without notice or gratuity.
quote: إذا وجد العامل أثناء ساعات العمل في حالة سكر بين أو تحت تأثير مخدر.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 61 item 6 (Arabic).

claim: The employer may not make workers pay for, or deduct from wages for, safety precautions.
quote: The Employer may not require their workers to bear or deduct from their wages any amount in return for providing these precautions.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 100.

claim: Where the employer must provide housing, it must meet the conditions set by ministerial decision.
quote: في جميع الأحوال التي يلتزم فيها صاحب العمل بتوفير سكن لعماله، يجب أن تتوافر في ذلك السكن الشروط والمواصفات التي يصدر بتحديدها قرار من الوزير.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 106 (second text, Arabic).

claim: If a worker dies or is injured at or because of work, the employer must report it at once to the police and the Ministry's department; the police investigate and send the report to the department and the employer.
quote: وجب على صاحب العمل أو من يقوم مقامه، إبلاغ الحادث فوراً إلى الشرطة والإدارة.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 108 (Arabic).

claim: An injured worker is treated at the employer's cost and gets full pay during treatment or for six months, whichever is shorter, then half pay until recovery or permanent disability is established.
quote: ويتقاضى العامل أجره كاملاً طوال مدة العلاج أو لمدة ستة أشهر، أيهما أقرب. فإذا استمر العلاج مدة تزيد على ستة أشهر تقاضى العامل نصف أجره الكامل حتى يتم شفاؤه أو يثبت عجزه الدائم، أيهما أقرب.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 109 (Arabic).

claim: Heirs of a worker who dies because of work, and a worker left permanently disabled, are entitled to compensation; death compensation is calculated under Islamic law, permanent total disability counts as death, and partial disability is a percentage under Schedule 2.
quote: The amount of Compensation / Indemnity in the case of death due to work is calculated according to the provisions of Islamic law. A work injury that results in permanent total disability is considered equivalent to death.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 110.

claim: There is no injury compensation if the worker injured himself on purpose, was under drugs or alcohol that caused the injury, deliberately broke safety instructions, or refused treatment without good reason.
quote: أن العامل كان واقعاً تحت تأثير مخدر أو خمر وقت حدوث الإصابة أو الوفاة وكان هذا المؤثر هو السبب في الإصابة أو الوفاة.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 111 (Arabic).

claim: The right to claim compensation for disability or death lapses one year after the final medical report or the death.
quote: يسقط الحق في المطالبة بالتعويض عن العجز أو الوفاة بانقضاء سنة واحدة من تاريخ التقرير الطبي النهائي
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 113 (Arabic).

claim: The employer must pay disability compensation within 15 days of the disability being established, and deposit death compensation with the competent court within 15 days of the death; the court distributes it to the heirs.
quote: على صاحب العمل أن يؤدي التعويض عن العجز، خلال مدة لا تجاوز خمسة عشر يوماً من تاريخ ثبوت عجز العامل
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 114 (Arabic).

claim: Medical disagreements between worker and employer about an injury are referred by the Ministry's department to the competent medical body, whose decision is final.
quote: وجب على الإدارة إحالة الأمر إلى الجهة الطبية المختصة، ويكون قرارها بشأن المسائل التي تدخل في اختصاصها المهني نهائياً.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Art. 112 (Arabic).

claim: A worker or employer with a dispute about the Labour Law or the contract must first submit it to the Ministry's department for amicable settlement.
quote: must submit the dispute to the Department / Directorate for amicable settlement.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official). Replaces Art. 115 bis.

claim: The department tries to settle the dispute within 7 days of submission and presents the result within the next 7 days; an agreed settlement is recorded, signed and has the force of an enforceable instrument.
quote: The Department / Directorate shall take the necessary procedures to settle the dispute amicably within a period not exceeding seven days from the date it is submitted to it, and shall present the result of the settlement to the two parties within the following seven days.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official).

claim: If there is no settlement, or a party rejects it or does not answer, the department must refer the dispute within 3 working days to the Labour Dispute Settlement Committee.
quote: the Department / Directorate must refer the dispute within the following three working days to the Labour Dispute Settlement Committee.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official).

claim: The committee secretariat sets a hearing within 7 working days of referral, and both sides are told the date at least 3 days before.
quote: set a hearing to consider the dispute on a date not exceeding seven working days from the date of referral. Each of the Employee / Worker and the Employer shall be notified of the date of the hearing at least three days before it is held.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official).

claim: Submitting a settlement request stops the legal time limit for losing the right to sue for those dues while these steps run.
quote: The submission of a request for settlement of the dispute to the Department / Directorate shall result in the suspension of the period legally prescribed for the forfeiture of the Case/Lawsuit claiming those rights
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official).

claim: A committee decision ending a dispute is an enforceable instrument, and the committee may use electronic systems after checking identity.
quote: The Committee may use the necessary electronic systems after verifying the identity of the Litigant / Adversary or the witness, as the case may be.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official).

claim: The committee alone decides individual disputes under the Labour Law or the contract, and must decide within three weeks of the first hearing.
quote: تختص اللجنة، دون غيرها، بالفصل في جميع المنازعات الفردية الناشئة عن تطبيق أحكام هذا القانون أو عن عقد العمل. وتفصل اللجنة في النزاع المعروض عليها خلال ثلاثة أسابيع من تاريخ أول جلسة لنظر النزاع أمامها.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Chapter 11 bis (Arabic).

claim: Committee decisions are immediately enforceable.
quote: تصدر قرارات اللجنة مشمولة بالنفاذ المعجل.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Chapter 11 bis (Arabic).

claim: Either side can appeal a committee decision to the Court of Appeal within 15 days (from the decision if present, or from notification if absent); the appeal does not stop enforcement unless the court orders it, and the court decides within 30 days of its first hearing.
quote: لذوي الشأن الطعن في القرار الصادر من لجنة فض المنازعات العمالية أمام الدائرة المختصة بمحكمة الاستئناف، وذلك خلال خمسة عشر يوماً من تاريخ صدور قرار اللجنة إذا كان حضورياً
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Chapter 11 bis (Arabic).

claim: The committee secretariat notifies both sides of procedures and decisions at their residence or workplace by registered letter or any other means that proves receipt.
quote: تتولى أمانة سر اللجنة إخطار طرفي المنازعة بالإجراءات والقرارات التي تصدرها اللجنة على محال إقامتهم أو مراكز أعمالهم بكتاب مسجل، أو بأي وسيلة أخرى تفيد العلم.
note: Al Meezan consolidated text of Law 14/2004 shown as In Force on 7 Nov 2026; article text as amended. Page date = law date. Chapter 11 bis (Arabic).

claim: Each Labour Dispute Settlement Committee is chaired by a Court of First Instance judge, with a Ministry of Labour representative and an accounting expert.
quote: each chaired by a judge of the Court of First Instance selected by the Supreme Judiciary Council, and with the membership of a representative of the Ministry of Labour and an expert in the field of accounting selected by the Minister.
note: Council of Ministers Decision 35/2026, published 2 Sep 2026.

claim: Each party may appear before the committee in person or authorise any representative, who need not be a relative.
quote: Each party to the dispute may appear before the Committee in person, or authorize a representative to appear on his behalf, even if such representative is not his spouse, relative, or in-law.
note: Council of Ministers Decision 35/2026.

claim: Any document not in Arabic must be filed with a certified Arabic translation from a licensed translation office.
quote: يجب أن يرفق بأي مستند محرر بغير اللغة العربية ترجمة معتمدة له إلى اللغة العربية من أحد مكاتب الترجمة المرخص لها بمزاولة أعمال الترجمة.
note: CM Decision 6/2018 Art. 8 (Arabic); amended 2022 and 2026 in other articles.

claim: The committee may strike out the case if the claimant or the claimant's representative attends none of the hearings, or decide it in a party's absence.
quote: يجوز للجنة شطب المنازعة إذا لم يحضر الطالب أو وكيله أي من الجلسات
note: CM Decision 6/2018 Art. 11 (Arabic).

claim: In 2022 five Labour Dispute Settlement Committees were set up at the Ministry.
quote: تُشكل بالوزارة خمس لجان لفض المنازعات العمالية
note: CM Decision 17/2022 Art. 2 (Arabic); Art. 2 para 1 later replaced by CM 35/2026 without a number of committees.

claim: A worker harmed by an employer's breach of the wage-payment article (Art. 66) may ask to change employer or to end the contract, and the employer must then pay the worker's journey home.
quote: The Employee / Worker harmed by the Employer’s violation of the provision of Article (66) of this Law / Act may submit a request to change his employer or a request to terminate the contractual relationship with the violating establishment, and in this case the violating establishment shall be obligated to bear the expenses of his return to his country.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official). New Art. 146 bis.

claim: Breaking the wage-payment article (Art. 66) is punishable by up to one year in prison and/or a fine of QR 2,000 to QR 10,000.
quote: Imprisonment for a period not exceeding one year, and a fine of not less than (2,000) two thousand riyals and not more than ten thousand (10,000) riyals, or either of these two penalties, shall be imposed on anyone who violates any of the provisions of Articles (66), (120 Item/7) of this Law / Act.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official). New text of Art. 145 bis.

claim: The Minister may suspend an employer's transactions with the Ministry for violations, including when collective disputes arise from late wages, but the suspension cannot stop contract attestation or renewal of workers' work permits and residence permits.
quote: nor shall the suspension include the attestation of Employment Contracts, or the renewal of Work Permits and residences of workers Reporting to those establishments.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official). New Art. 146 bis.

claim: The Labour Law does not cover domestic workers such as drivers, nannies, cooks and gardeners (they have their own law), nor casual, agricultural, part-time or freelance workers unless the Cabinet extends it.
quote: Domestic employees such as drivers, nannies, cooks, gardeners, and the like.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official). New text of Art. 3.

claim: Workers may hold a peaceful strike only under strict conditions, including approval of three-quarters of the workers, two weeks' written notice to the employer and the Ministry, Ministry approval coordinated with the Interior Ministry, at most six working days, and never in vital facilities; strike days are unpaid.
quote: The Employer shall be granted a period of not less than two weeks before commencing the Strike, and the approval of the Ministry shall be obtained, after coordination with the Ministry of Interior regarding the time and place of the Strike.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official). New text of Art. 120.

claim: Inciting other workers to strike for unlawful reasons in a way that disrupts the employer's business is a ground for dismissal without notice or gratuity.
quote: If the Employee / Worker incites the remaining workers to Strike for unlawful reasons and this results in disrupting the business of the Employer’s establishments.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official). New Art. 61 item 11.

claim: Workers may be employed in certain professions only after getting the training and test certificate from a Ministry-accredited training centre; the list of professions is published on the Ministry's website.
quote: workers may be employed in certain professions only after obtaining the training and testing Testimony required for that from the training centers accredited by the Ministry.
note: Law 9/2026 published 11 Jun 2026; Al Meezan English is machine-translated (Arabic is official). New Art. 23 bis.

claim: The minimum wage is QR 1,000 a month; if the employer does not provide suitable housing or food, it must also pay at least QR 500 a month for housing and QR 300 a month for food.
quote: يكون الحد الأدنى للأجر الذي يستحقه العامل أو المستخدم (1,000) ريال شهرياً. وفي حالة عدم توفير صاحب العمل السكن الملائم أو الغذاء للعامل أو المستخدم، يكون الحد الأدنى لبدل السكن (500) ريال شهرياً، والحد الأدنى لبدل الغذاء (300) ريال شهرياً.
value: QR 1,000/month basic + QR 500 housing + QR 300 food if not provided
note: Ministerial Decision 25/2020 Art. 2 (Arabic). No later decision changing the amounts found on Al Meezan (searched 'الحد الأدنى' on 7 Nov 2026).

claim: The minimum wage decision took effect six months after publication in the Official Gazette.
quote: ويُعمل به بعد ستة أشهر من تاريخ نشر، في الجريدة الرسمية.
note: MD 25/2020 Art. 5 (Arabic); published 9 Sep 2020 per Al Meezan.

claim: No worker's or domestic worker's wage may be below the minimum wage, and any agreement to the contrary is void; it applies whatever the worker's skill or job.
quote: لا يجوز أن يقل أجر العامل أو المستخدم عن الحد الأدنى للأجور المنصوص عليه في المادة السابقة، ويقع باطلا كل اتفاق على خلاف ذلك.
note: Law 17/2020 Art. 3 (Arabic).

claim: The minimum wage is set by ministerial decision and reviewed at least once a year.
quote: يحدد الحد الأدنى للأجور، بقرار من الوزير، وتتم مراجعته مرة واحدة على الأقل كل سنة
note: Law 17/2020 Art. 2 (Arabic).

claim: From 1 June to 15 September each year, work in the sun or in open workplaces without shade and ventilation may not be done between 10 am and 3:30 pm.
quote: خلال المدة من (1) يونيو وحتى (15) سبتمبر من كل عام، بحيث لا يجوز مباشرة العمل في الفترة من الساعة العاشرة صباحاً حتى الساعة الثالثة والنصف مساءً.
note: MD 17/2021 Art. 2 (Arabic).

claim: Employers must give free cool drinking water throughout work, shaded rest areas, light loose clothing, and free yearly medical checks for conditions that raise heat-stress risk.
quote: توفير مياه الشرب المجانية لجميع العاملين بدرجة برودة مناسبة طوال فترة العمل.
note: MD 17/2021 Art. 4 items 3, 4, 6 (Arabic).

claim: Work must stop at any workplace where the wet-bulb globe temperature (WBGT) heat index exceeds 32.1 degrees.
quote: رصد وتسجيل مستويات الظروف المناخية في مكان العمل، وإيقاف العمل في أماكن العمل التي يزيد مؤشر الحرارة لجهاز البُصيلمة الرطبة الكروية على (32,1) درجة.
note: MD 17/2021 Art. 4 item 9 (Arabic).

claim: A worker may stop work and complain to the Ministry if there is good reason to believe heat stress threatens his safety or health, telling supervisors; the employer may not dismiss him, deny his rights or discriminate against him for it.
quote: يحق للعامل التوقف عن العمل والتقدم بشكوى للوزارة إذا توفر سبب وجيه يدفعه إلى الاعتقاد بأن الإجهاد الحراري يهدد سلامته أو صحته
note: MD 17/2021 Art. 6 (Arabic).

claim: Employers must post the daily working-hours schedule in a visible place.
quote: على كل صاحب عمل أن يضع جدولاً بتحديد ساعات العمل اليومية طبقاً لأحكام هذا القرار، وأن يضع هذا الجدول في مكان ظاهر
note: MD 17/2021 Art. 3 (Arabic).

claim: In shared workers' rooms each bed must have at least 6 square metres, and corridors, roofs and basements may not be used as rooms.
quote: ألا تقل المساحة المخصصة للسرير الواحد داخل الغرفة المشتركة عن ستة أمتار.
note: MD 18/2014 Art. 2 (Arabic).

claim: Housing must give each worker a bed with mattress and covers, lockable storage for documents and belongings, and enough air conditioning.
quote: مرافق وأمكنة بها مخازن قابلة للقفل بحيث يستطيع العمال الوصول والوصول إليها بحرية وحفظ وثائقهم وممتلكاتهم الشخصية.
note: MD 18/2014 Art. 3 (Arabic).

claim: Housing must have sufficient and suitable air conditioning.
quote: أجهزة تكييف الهواء الكافية والمناسبة.
note: MD 18/2014 Art. 3 item 3 (Arabic).

claim: There must be one full bathroom for every six workers at most.
quote: يلتزم صاحب العمل بتوفير دورة مياه كاملة لكل ستة عمال كحد أقصى
note: MD 18/2014 Art. 5 (Arabic).

claim: The employer may not deduct any money from workers for housing, its furnishing or maintenance.
quote: لا يجوز لصاحب العمل استقطاع أية مبالغ مالية من العمال نظير توفير السكن وتجهيزاته أو صيانته.
note: MD 18/2014 Art. 12 (Arabic).

claim: Employers must transfer monthly wages to the worker's account at a financial institution in Qatar through the Wage Protection System (WPS) within seven days of the due date, and the wage is due on the first day of each calendar month.
quote: Employers are required to transfer the wages of employees hired on an annual or monthly wage to the employee's account in financial institutions within the State, within seven days from the date such wages are due, through the Wage Protection System (WPS). The wage of the employee is due on the first day of every Gregorian month.
value: via WPS bank transfer, due 1st of month, paid within 7 days
note: Minister of Labour Decision 50/2026, published 1 Sep 2026.

claim: An employer that breaks the WPS rule can have new work permits and all its Ministry transactions stopped until it proves it has paid all late wages.
quote: ويُرفع الوقف بقرار من الوزير أو من يفوضه، بعد تقديم صاحب العمل ما يثبت قيامه بالتحويل الكامل لجميع الأجور المتأخرة.
note: MD 4/2015 Art. 4 (Arabic).

claim: The Workers' Support and Insurance Fund pays workers the dues decided by the Labour Dispute Settlement Committees, then recovers the money from the employer.
quote: صرف مستحقات العمال التي تفصل فيها لجان فض المنازعات العمالية، ثم اقتضاء ما تم صرفه من صاحب العمل.
note: Law 17/2018 Art. 5 item 2 (Arabic).

claim: The Fund pays workers' dues on final committee decisions, final court judgments, late monthly wages where the public interest requires, and emergencies.
quote: يتولى الصندوق صرف مستحقات العمال في الحالات التالية:
note: WSIF Chairman Decision 2/2022 Art. 2 (Arabic).

claim: The Fund pays at most three months' gross salary up to QR 20,000 for workers of operating companies, two months up to QR 12,000 for dissolved companies, and three months up to QR 8,000 for domestic workers, unless the chairman decides otherwise.
quote: الشركات القائمة: براتب إجمالي لثلاثة أشهر وبحد أقصى (20,000) عشرين ألف ريال. 2- الشركات المنقضية: براتب إجمالي لشهرين وبحد أقصى (12,000) اثني عشر ألف ريال. 3- المستخدمين في المنازل: براتب إجمالي لثلاثة أشهر وبحد أقصى (8,000) ثمانية ألاف ريال.
value: 3 months' gross salary up to QR 20,000 (operating company); 2 months up to QR 12,000 (dissolved)
note: WSIF Decision 2/2022 Art. 4 (Arabic).

claim: The worker or a representative applies to the Fund on its form with a certified copy of the committee decision or court judgment bearing the enforcement formula; a representative needs a notarised power of attorney, and heirs of a dead worker can apply with death and heirship documents.
quote: مرفقاً به نسخة طبق الأصل من قرار اللجنة مشمولة بالصيغة التنفيذية، أو نسخة طبق الأصل من الأحكام القضائية الصادرة بشأن المنازعة محل الطلب، مشمولة بالصيغة التنفيذية
note: WSIF Decision 2/2022 Art. 5 (Arabic).

claim: The Fund runs an electronic platform for submitting and following up applications.
quote: يُنشئ الصندوق منصة إلكترونية لتقديم طلبات صرف المستحقات العمالية ومتابعتها
note: WSIF Decision 2/2022 Art. 3 (Arabic).

claim: The Fund pays on a committee decision only if it was not appealed within 15 days and the worker and employer have not made an amicable settlement.
quote: ألا يكون قد تم الطعن على قرار اللجنة، خلال الخمسة عشر يوماً التالية لصدور القرار
note: WSIF Decision 2/2022 Art. 11 (Arabic).

claim: A Fund application is shelved if a written amicable settlement between worker and employer exists, even if the employer has not carried it out.
quote: إذا ثبت للصندوق وجود تسوية ودية، مُثبتة بالكتابة، بين العامل وصاحب العمل، حتى ولو لم تُنفذ تلك التسوية.
note: WSIF Decision 2/2022 Art. 8 item 4 (Arabic).

claim: The Fund may bring forward payment if the worker has left Qatar for good or shows he will, or has died or been disabled.
quote: إذا كان العامل قد غادر البلاد مغادرة نهائية، أو قدم ما يفيد أنه سوف يغادر البلاد مغادرة نهائية.
note: WSIF Decision 2/2022 Art. 16 (Arabic).

claim: The employer must give the worker's passport back after finishing residence permit procedures, unless the worker asks in writing for the employer to keep it, and must hand it over on request.
quote: The Employer must hand over the expatriate’s passport or travel document after completing the procedures for the License or its renewal, unless the expatriate requests in writing that the Employer retains it on his behalf, provided that it is handed over to him upon request.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 8.

claim: Keeping a worker's passport in breach of Article 8 is punishable by a fine of up to QR 25,000.
quote: A fine not exceeding (25,000) twenty-five thousand riyals shall be imposed on anyone who violates the provisions of Article (8/ Paragraph Three) of this Law / Act.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 39.

claim: The sponsor must do the residence permit procedures and renew it within 90 days of expiry.
quote: The sponsor is obligated to carry out the procedures for the License and its renewal within a period not exceeding ninety days from the date of its expiration.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 8.

claim: Within 30 days of the worker's arrival the employer must let the worker visit the authorities to complete the residence permit, and the worker may not refuse.
quote: The applicant must enable the expatriate to visit the competent authorities within thirty days from the date the expatriate entered the State, to complete the procedures for obtaining a residence or visit permit, and the expatriate may not refuse to complete these procedures.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 10.

claim: A worker under the Labour Law may leave Qatar temporarily or for good while the contract runs; an employer may ask the Ministry of Labour in advance to require prior approval for named workers, at most 5% of its staff.
quote: The expatriate subject to the Labor Law referred to, has the right to temporary exit or final departure from the country during the validity of the employment contract.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 7 as amended (2020).

claim: A migrant prevented from leaving for any reason can complain to the Expatriate Exit Grievances Committee, which must decide within three working days.
quote: If the expatriate is prevented from leaving the country for any reason, he may resort to the Committee for Expatriate Exit Grievances
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 7.

claim: The Exit Grievances Committee must decide within three working days.
quote: The Committee must decide on the Raising a Grievance within three working days.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 7.

claim: A resident may not stay outside Qatar for more than six months in a row unless he gets permission to return before leaving or within a year of leaving, by paying the fee, as long as no more than 60 days have passed since the residence permit expired.
quote: may not remain outside the State continuously for more than six months, unless he obtains, before his departure or before one year has passed since his exit, permission to return from the Competent Authority
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 14.

claim: A migrant must show his passport or residence permit to the authorities when asked, and must report a lost or damaged passport or residence permit immediately and get a replacement.
quote: In the event of loss or damage to the passport, travel document, or residence permit, the expatriate must notify the Competent Authority immediately upon discovering the loss or damage
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 15.

claim: A migrant licensed to work for a particular employer must not leave that employer's work or work for an entity he is not authorised to work for.
quote: must not violate the purpose for which he was licensed, leave the employment of his sponsor, or work for an entity not authorized for him.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 16.

claim: The employer must notify the authorities within 14 days of a worker leaving his job.
quote: Notify the Competent Authority within fourteen days from the date the expatriate leaves his employment
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 19.

claim: The recruiter pays deportation costs; if the worker was working illegally for another entity, that entity pays; if it cannot be identified the worker pays, and if he cannot, the recruiter pays.
quote: If it is proven that the expatriate was working for another entity in violation of the provisions of this Law / Act, that entity shall bear the cost of his deportation. If it is impossible to identify such entity, the expatriate shall bear those expenses.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 19.

claim: The recruiter pays to prepare and bury a dead migrant in Qatar, or, if an heir asks, to transport the body to the migrant's home country.
quote: If one of the heirs of the deceased or any concerned party requests the transfer of the body outside the State, the recruiter shall bear the transportation costs to the expatriate’s original home or permanent place of residence.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 19.

claim: A migrant must leave Qatar within 90 days after his residence permit expires or is cancelled or its purpose ends.
quote: within ninety days from the date of expiration or cancellation of the License or the end of the purpose.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 24.

claim: A worker dismissed for disciplinary reasons who does not appeal, or loses a final appeal, may not return to Qatar to work for four years after leaving.
quote: he may not return to the State for work except after four years from the date of his departure.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 26.

claim: A migrant ordered to be deported can be held in a designated place for 30 days, renewable once.
quote: detain the expatriate against whom a Judgment / Ruling has been issued for deportation or an order for removal from the State in the designated place for thirty days, which may be renewed for another similar period.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 28.

claim: Entering or leaving illegally, trading in visas, overstaying, leaving the sponsor's work or working for an unauthorised employer, employing without a contract, or not leaving after the permit ends is punishable by up to three years in prison and/or a fine of up to QR 50,000.
quote: the Penalty / Sentence shall be imprisonment for a period not exceeding three years and a fine not exceeding (50,000) fifty thousand Riyals, or one of these sentences
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 38.

claim: Selling, transferring or trading entry permits (visas) to others, with or without payment, is prohibited.
quote: It is prohibited to transfer the permits to others, to dispose of them in any way, or for them to be traded by others, whether the transfer, disposition, or trading is for consideration or without consideration.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 4.

claim: Not completing residence permit steps on time, not reporting a lost passport or permit, or not showing them when asked is fined up to QR 10,000.
quote: A fine not exceeding (10,000) ten thousand riyals shall be imposed on anyone who violates any of the provisions of Articles (5/ Paragraph One), (8/Paragraph One and Two), (10/ Paragraph One), (13/ Paragraph One and Three), (15) of this Law / Act.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 40.

claim: For these offences the Interior Ministry can offer a settlement (conciliation) for a fixed amount instead of prosecution; an accused person may not leave Qatar until he pays it, is acquitted or serves the sentence, unless a guarantor undertakes to pay.
quote: The accused of any of the Crimes stipulated in this Law / Act is not permitted to leave the State before paying the specified amount for settlement, the issuance of a Final Judgment of acquittal in the Lawsuit / Legal Action, or the execution of the Penalty / Sentence imposed upon him, as the case may be.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Arts. 42-44.

claim: The Minister can cancel the residence permit and deport a migrant who does not pay the settlement amount or a court fine.
quote: the minister may order the cancellation of the residence License of the expatriate accused of any of the Crimes stipulated in this Law / Act and order his deportation from the State, if he does not pay the specified amount for settlement
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 44.

claim: The Minister may waive or reduce the settlement amount for public-interest or humanitarian reasons.
quote: exempt the accused from the reconciliation amount stipulated for any of the Crimes specified in this Law / Act, or reduce it to the extent he deems appropriate.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 45.

claim: The settlement amount is QR 12,000 for offences including leaving the sponsor's work or working for another (Art. 16), trading visas (Art. 4), and not leaving after the residence permit ends (Art. 24).
quote: (2/فقرة أولى)، (3)، (4/فقرة ثالثة)، (8/فقرة ثالثة)، (16/فقرة أولى)، (19/بند 1)، (23/فقرة أولى)، (24/فقرة أولى وثانية)، (35) (12,000) ريال
note: Conciliation table attached to Law 21/2015 (Arabic), Al Meezan attachment.

claim: For late residence permit procedures (Art. 8 paras 1-2, Art. 10) the settlement is QR 10 per day of delay, up to QR 6,000; overstaying a visit (Art. 11) is QR 200 a day up to QR 12,000.
quote: (11/فقرة ثانية) (200) ريال عن كل يوم تأخير وبحد أقصى (12,000) ريال. (8/فقرة أولى وثانية)، (13/فقرة أولى وثالثة) (10) ريالات عن كل يوم تأخير وبحد أقصى (6,000) ريال.
note: Conciliation table attached to Law 21/2015 (Arabic).

claim: Since 2020 a migrant worker may move to another employer under the rules set by the Ministry of Labour (no employer consent required in the law).
quote: للوافد للعمل أن ينتقل للعمل لدى صاحب عمل آخر، وفقاً للقواعد والإجراءات التي حددها وزارة التنمية الإدارية والعمل والشؤون الاجتماعية
note: Decree-Law 19/2020 Art. 1 (Arabic); also repealed Art. 22. Conflicts with the older MOI 'Sponsorship Change' page (NOC, 2 years) - see that row.

claim: No one may employ migrants without a work contract or let its recruited workers work for others, except Ministry-approved secondment of up to six months (renewable) or part-time work with both the employer's and the worker's consent.
quote: يُحظّر على أي شخص طبيعي أو معنوي استخدام وافدين دون إبرام عقد عمل
note: Decree-Law 19/2020 Art. 1 new Art. 23 (Arabic).

claim: The authorities may grant residence to a resident's spouse, sons studying up to age 25 and unmarried daughters, under conditions set by ministerial decision.
quote: The competent authority may grant residence Licenses to the spouse of the residence License holder and to his male children who have not completed their university studies up to the age of twenty-five, as well as to his unmarried daughters.
note: Al Meezan consolidated English text of Law 21/2015 (In Force on 7 Nov 2026). Page date = law date. Art. 12.

claim: Importing or exporting narcotics for trafficking is punishable by death or life imprisonment and a fine of QR 300,000 to QR 500,000.
quote: يعاقب بالإعدام أو الحبس المؤبد وبغرامة لا تزيد على خمسمائة ألف ريال ولا تقل عن ثلاثمائة ألف ريال كل من: أ- إستورد بقصد الاتجار أو صدّر مواد مخدرة
note: Law 9/1987 Art. 34 as amended (Arabic), Al Meezan.

claim: Possessing, buying, selling, handing over or transporting narcotics for trafficking is punishable by 10 to 20 years in prison and a fine of QR 200,000 to QR 400,000.
quote: يُعاقب بالحبس مدة لا تزيد على عشرين سنة ولا تقل عن عشر سنوات وبغرامة لا تزيد على أربعمائة ألف ريال ولا تقل عن مائتي ألف ريال
note: Law 9/1987 Art. 35 as amended (Arabic).

claim: Possessing, handing over or transporting narcotics even without intent to trade or use is punishable by 3 to 7 years in prison and a fine of QR 100,000 to QR 200,000.
quote: يعاقب بالحبس مدة لا تزيد على سبع سنوات ولا تقل عن ثلاث سنوات وبغرامة لا تزيد على مائتي ألف ريال ولا تقل عن مائة ألف ريال كل من حاز أو أحرز أو أشترى أو سلم أو نقل
note: Law 9/1987 Art. 41 (Arabic).

claim: Possessing or using narcotics for personal use is punishable by 6 months to 3 years in prison and a fine of QR 10,000 to QR 20,000.
quote: يعاقب بالحبس مدة لا تجاوز ثلاث سنوات ولا تقل عن ستة أشهر وبغرامة لا تزيد على عشرين ألف ريال ولا تقل عن عشرة ألاف ريال
note: Law 9/1987 Art. 37 as amended (Arabic).

claim: Drinking alcohol in a public place, or being drunk in the street, is punishable by up to six months in prison and/or a fine of up to QR 3,000.
quote: يُعاقب بالحبس مدة لا تجاوز ستة أشهر، وبالغرامة التي لا تزيد على ثلاثة آلاف ريال، أو بإحدى هاتين العقوبتين، كل من تعاطى خمراً، أو شراباً مسكراً، في مكان عام
note: Penal Code Art. 270 (Arabic), Al Meezan.

claim: Importing, making or preparing alcohol is punishable by up to three years in prison and a fine of up to QR 10,000.
quote: يعاقب بالحبس مدة لا تجاوز ثلاث سنوات، وبالغرامة التي لا تزيد على عشرة آلاف ريال، كل من استورد، أو صَّدر، أو صنع، أو استخرج، أو حضر خمراً، أو شراباً مسكراً.
note: Penal Code Art. 272 (Arabic).

claim: Selling, buying, transporting or holding alcohol for trade is punishable by up to three years in prison and/or a fine of up to QR 10,000.
quote: كل من باع أو اشترى، أو سلم، أو تسلم، أو نقل أو حاز أو أحرز خمراً أو شراباً مسكراً، أو تعامل أو توسط في التعامل فيهما، بأي وجه بقصد الإتجار أو الترويج.
note: Penal Code Art. 273 (Arabic).

claim: Health insurance covering basic health care is compulsory for migrants and visitors.
quote: يكون التأمين الصحي إلزامياً، لضمان تقديم خدمات الرعاية الصحية الأساسية، للوافدين والزائرين.
note: Law 22/2021 Art. 8 (Arabic). Took effect 6 months after publication (Art. final).

claim: Under the law a residence permit may not be issued or renewed, and a migrant may not be employed, without proof of compulsory health insurance for the whole stay, unless exempted.
quote: لا يجوز إصدار سمة دخول لوافد أو زائر أو تجديدها أو منح ترخيص الإقامة أو تجديده، كما لا يجوز توظيف وافد، إلا بعد تقديم ما يثبت اشتراكه في التأمين الصحي الإلزامي طوال مدة الإقامة
note: Law 22/2021 Art. 10 (Arabic).

claim: The employer must pay the health insurance premiums for its workers, give them a health insurance card, and may not charge them for care caused by its failure to keep cover valid.
quote: دفع أقساط التأمين الصحي لتوفير التغطية التأمينية لخدمات الرعاية الصحية الأساسية للعاملين لديه
note: Law 22/2021 Art. 13 (Arabic).

claim: Health care providers must give an insured person emergency care without asking for payment until the danger is over, even outside the insurer's network.
quote: تقديم خدمات الرعاية الصحية للمستفيد في الحالات الطارئة دون مطالبته بدفع أي مبالغ مالية
note: Law 22/2021 Art. 16 item 5 / provider duties (Arabic).

claim: Exempt from compulsory health insurance are, among others, holders of temporary residence permits, four domestic workers of each Qatari citizen, detainees and prisoners, transit passengers, and on-arrival visitors for 30 days.
quote: حاملو تصاريح الإقامة المؤقتة.
note: CM Decision 9/2023 Art. 1 (Arabic).

claim: For a first residence permit on company sponsorship the MOI needs the labour contract attested by the Labour Department, the signed application form, the worker's original passport, a copy of the company's establishment ID, a photo and a blood group certificate.
quote: Labour contract attested by Labour Department
note: MOI service page, undated (footer 2021); fees may have changed.

claim: Fees on company sponsorship: work permit QR 100 a year; residence permit QR 1,000 a year plus QR 100 for the ID card.
quote: Residence permit fee: QR 1000 annually + QR 100 for ID card (for the period of residence permit.
note: MOI service page, undated (footer 2021); fees may have changed.

claim: Residence permit renewal needs the sponsor's signed and stamped form, payment of the work and residence permit fees, the worker's original passport and the company's establishment ID; it can be done at the Expatriates Affairs Department, MOI service centres, Metrash2 or MOI e-services.
quote: Expatriates Affairs Department & MOI Services Centres. This service also available on Metrash2 Mobile app and MOI e-services portal.
note: MOI service page, undated (footer 2021); fees may have changed.

claim: Cancelling a residence permit costs QR 20 (personal sponsorship) or QR 50 (company), and the form is signed by both the sponsor and the sponsored person; it can be done at service centres, Metrash2 or MOI e-services.
quote: fill in the application form and sign by the sponsor and the sponsored person .
note: MOI service page, undated (footer 2021); fees may have changed.

claim: Moving a residence permit to a new passport (after expiry, loss or damage) costs QAR 100 and needs the old and new passports, the form, and a loss report if the passport was lost; available on Metrash2, MOI service centres and Passport headquarters.
quote: Bring old and new passports
note: MOI service page, undated (footer 2021); fees may have changed.

claim: The MOI 'Leave Notification' service for expatriates leaving on leave is free and available on MOI e-services, Metrash2 and MOI service centres.
quote: This service is provided free of charge for expatriates to exit the country on leave .
note: MOI service page, undated (footer 2021); fees may have changed.

claim: An employer files an absconding report against a worker free of charge, with a signed form, the worker's passport or a copy and the sponsor's ID or establishment ID, at the Search and Follow-up Department, MOI service centres or Metrash2.
quote: Search & Follow up Department, MOI Services Centres, Metrash2 Mobile App
note: MOI service page, undated (footer 2021); fees may have changed.

claim: Workers can register a complaint against their sponsor for abuse at the MOI Search and Follow-up Department, free, with a copy of the passport or ID and a written complaint.
quote: This service is provided for the employees to register complaints against their sponsors in case of abuse.
note: MOI service page, undated (footer 2021); fees may have changed.

claim: The abuse complaint needs a passport or ID copy and a written complaint, and is filed at the Search and Follow-up Department.
quote: written complaint from the employee Location Search and Follow up Department
note: MOI service page, undated (footer 2021); fees may have changed.

claim: An old MOI 'Sponsorship Change' page still online says a sponsored person must have completed two years with the same sponsor and needs a no-objection certificate (NOC) from the present sponsor, with fees of QR 2,000-3,000 for companies.
quote: The sponsored person shall have completed two years inside the country with the same sponsor .
note: MOI service page, undated (footer 2021); fees may have changed. Conflicts with Decree-Law 19/2020 (L0122), which lets workers move under Ministry of Labour rules without these conditions; the law is the rule.; re-check: conflict-settled -> R0001, R0002, R0003, R0004 (Law is the rule: MOI Decision 51/2020 plus DL 19/2020 [L0122]. The old MOI page and the 2021 Hukoomi page [R0004] are outdated.)

claim: METRASH is the Ministry of Interior's free app giving citizens and residents more than 400 MOI services (traffic, residence, visas and others), with an e-wallet of official documents, in Arabic, English, French, Spanish, Hindi and Urdu.
quote: Metrash Application offer Citizens & Residents of Qatar to access more than (400) services provided by MOI through different mobile devices.
note: App Store listing published by Ministry of Interior - Qatar; version 1.2.6 dated 15 Oct 2026.

claim: The app is available in Arabic, English, French, Spanish, Hindi and Urdu, and lets users reach official documents through an e-wallet.
quote: Available in several languages: Arabic, English, French, Spanish, Hindi and Urdu. Metrash able the users to access E-wallet to reach for the official documents.
note: App Store listing, Ministry of Interior - Qatar.

claim: An adult resident gets a health card at the nearest PHCC health centre with a valid QID, a 4x3 cm photo, a utility bill as proof of address and a credit or debit card to pay QR 100 (no cash).
quote: Adult Residents: A valid Qatar Identification Card (QID), 4cmx3cm photo, and credit/debit card to pay the 100 QR fees.
note: PHCC page, no page date found.

claim: All applicants must show a utility bill (phone, water or electricity) as proof of address, and must pay by card; no cash.
quote: All applicants must submit a copy of a utilities bill (Phone, Water / Electricity) as a proof of place or area of residence. You must pay using a credit card. No cash is accepted.
note: PHCC page, undated.

claim: The health card gives access to PHCC health centres and Hamad Medical Corporation facilities, with subsidised consultations and prescriptions at government pharmacies.
quote: Holders of a health card can also have their prescriptions filled at a government-run pharmacy at subsidized rates.
note: PHCC page, undated.

claim: Cards can be renewed at PHCC centres and HMC hospitals or online through Hukoomi; replacing a lost valid card costs non-Qataris QR 100, or QR 200 if it had expired.
quote: If you lose your health card and it has expired Qatari nationals will need to pay QR100 for a replacement and non-Qataris will need to pay QR200 for a replacement.
note: PHCC page, undated.

claim: Health cards can be renewed online through Hukoomi.
quote: Cards can also be renewed online via Hukoomi.
note: PHCC page, undated.

claim: The Bangladesh Embassy in Doha issues a Travel Permit to a Bangladeshi without a valid passport who wants to return to Bangladesh.
quote: A Travel Permit is issued to a Bangladeshi citizen who does not possess a valid Bangladeshi Passport but intends to return to Bangladesh.
note: Embassy page last updated 18 Apr 2026.

claim: A Travel Permit needs the completed form, a copy of the previous passport, three passport photos and the applicant in person for an interview.
quote: Copy of previous passport. Three passport size photographs. Physical presence of the applicant at the Embassy for an interview.
note: Embassy page last updated 18 Apr 2026.

claim: The Travel Permit fee is QR 50 (ordinary) or QR 98 (urgent), non-refundable; applications are taken 8:30 am to 4 pm Sunday to Thursday, and the permit is valid for 3 months only.
quote: QR 50.00 for ordinary delivery and QR 98. for urgent delivery.
value: QR 50 ordinary, QR 98 urgent; valid 3 months
note: Embassy page last updated 18 Apr 2026.

claim: A Travel Permit is valid for 3 months only.
quote: A Travel Permit is valid for 3 months only.
note: Embassy page last updated 18 Apr 2026.

claim: The embassy's Labour Wing has a Counsellor (Labour), phone +974 4037 4725, and a First Secretary (Labour), phone +974 4467 1499, email labour.doha@mofa.gov.bd.
quote: First Secretary (Labour) Ph: +974-4467 1499 labour.doha@mofa.gov.bd
note: Embassy officers list updated 15 Jun 2026.

claim: The Counsellor (Labour) phone is +974 4037 4725.
quote: Counsellor (Labour) Ph: +974-4037 4725
note: Embassy officers list updated 15 Jun 2026.

claim: The Passport and Visa Wing's First Secretary is on +974 4039 4628, qatarpassportandvisawing@gmail.com.
quote: First Secretary (Passport & Visa) Ph: +974-4039 4628 qatarpassportandvisawing@gmail.com
note: Embassy officers list updated 15 Jun 2026.

claim: Embassy phone +974 4467 1927, hotline +974 3366 2000, email mission.doha@mofa.gov.bd.
note: Embassy contact page last updated 20 Oct 2025.

claim: In a labour dispute a worker can go to the labour court or apply on the online platform under Qatari law, and can get advice and help from the embassy.
quote: In case of any labour dispute, a worker can go to the labour court or submit an application on the online platform in accordance with Qatari law. In addition, they can take advice and assistance from the Embassy for any disputes.
note: Embassy page last updated 6 Nov 2021.

claim: The employer bears all costs of repatriating a body and must first get a no-objection certificate (NOC) from the embassy; in exceptional cases the embassy arranges it with relatives, the community or the Wage Earners' Welfare Board.
quote: The respective company/employer will bear all the expenses and facilitate the repatriation of a dead body. Before that, the company/employer has to collect NOC from the Embassy.
note: Embassy page last updated 6 Nov 2021.

claim: For workplace or road-accident deaths, the heirs give the embassy a power of attorney; the embassy's enlisted lawyer takes the case to court, the compensation cheque goes to the embassy's account, and the embassy sends it to the Wage Earners' Welfare Board, which pays the heirs.
quote: The legal heirs of the deceased authorize the Embassy through Power of Attorney to take legal course for the realization of the compensation money.
note: Embassy page last updated 26 Oct 2021.

claim: After the court case, the compensation goes to the embassy's bank account and is sent through the Wage Earners' Welfare Board to the heirs.
quote: Then the Embassy remits the money to the account of the Wage Earners Welfare Board which disburse the money to the legal heirs of the deceased.
note: Embassy page last updated 26 Oct 2021.

claim: The embassy visits hospitals and, on request of the hospital or relatives, arranges repatriation of poor and sick Bangladeshis.
quote: On request from the hospital authorities or relatives of the sick person, the Embassy facilitates the repatriation process of a poor and sick Bangladeshi expatriate.
note: Embassy page last updated 6 Nov 2021.

claim: A worker in Qatar without a BMET clearance card can join the Wage Earners' Welfare Board: apply online at wewb.gov.bd, print the information page, and pay QR 140 at the embassy counter.
quote: The applicants need to pay QR 140.00 for each membership application.
note: Embassy page updated 11 Nov 2025. Conflicts with the embassy FAQ (2021) which says QR 170 (see FAQ row); the newer page is taken as current.; re-check: conflict-settled (WEWB Tk 6,500 equivalent [B0065] is the rule (fee rise B0055); QR 140 predates it.)

claim: A worker who cannot find his company after arrival should take his visa and passport copy to the Labour Relations Department (Sanaiya Street 13, or Al Huda Tower opposite City Center) or the nearest police station, or ask the Search and Follow-up Department (CID) or the Public Prosecution's residency affairs for the employer's number, and can ask the embassy labour wing for help.
quote: কোম্পানি খুঁজে পাওয়ার জন্য আপনার ভিসা ও পাসপোর্ট কপি নিয়ে লেবার রিলেশন ডিপার্টমেন্টে (সানাইয়া-১৩ নং অথবা সিটি সেন্টারের বিপরীতে আল হুদা টাওয়ারের ১ম তলায়) অথবা নিকটস্থ পুলিশ স্টেশনে গিয়ে যোগাযোগ করুন।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: If the company does not issue a Qatar ID, ask its PRO (mandoob), manager or HR; if it still does not, take the visa and passport to the Public Prosecution's residency affairs office inside the CID building and complain against the company.
quote: কাতারি আইডি ইস্যু না করলে ভিসা ও পাসপোর্ট নিয়ে কাতারের সিইআইডি অফিসের ভিতরে অবস্থিত পাবলিক প্রসিকিউশনের রেসিডেন্সি অ্যাফেয়ার্সে গিয়ে কোম্পানির বিরুদ্ধে অভিযোগ করুন।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: For unpaid wages the embassy advises complaining at the Labour Relations Department, then the labour ministry, then the Public Prosecution's residency affairs if unresolved, with the embassy labour wing's help if needed.
quote: বকেয়া বেতন-ভাতা পাওয়ার জন্য লেবার রিলেশন ডিপার্টমেন্টে (সানাইয়া-১৩ নং অথবা সিটি সেন্টারের বিপরীতে আল হুদা টাওয়ারের ১ম তলায়) গিয়ে অভিযোগ করুন।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: If a Qatar ID is lost, ask the company's PRO, manager or HR to apply for a replacement through Metrash; if the company does not help, go to any immigration (Jawazat) service centre with the original passport and a copy of the Qatar ID.
quote: কোম্পানির সহযোগিতা না পেলে মূল পাসপোর্ট ও কাতার আইডির ফটোকপি নিয়ে জাওয়াযাতের (ইমিগ্রেশন) যে কোন সার্ভিস সেন্টারে যোগাযোগ করুন।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: A worker could see his contract online by logging in with Qatar ID or visa number and registered mobile and an OTP; the embassy advises collecting a hard copy from the employer beforehand because contracts are often not online.
quote: নিয়োগদাতা বা কোম্পানির মানদুব (পিআরও), মুদির (ম্যানেজার) বা এইচআর এর কাছ থেকে আপনার চুক্তিপত্রের হার্ডকপি অবশ্যই পূর্ব থেকে সংগ্রহ করবেন। কেননা অনেক সময় চুক্তিপত্র অনলাইনে পাওয়া যায় না।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links. Uses old ADLSA link empcont.adlsa.gov.qa; current link not found.

claim: If the employer files a 'runaway' (absconding, balagh huroob) case, go without delay to the Niyabah (prosecution) court inside the CID building, get the form for a grievance against the absconding report, fill it in typed, attach your ID, timesheet and agreement, and attend the hearing date you are given.
quote: আপনি বিলম্ব না করে সিইআইডির ভিতরস্থ নিয়াবাহ কোর্টে গিয়ে সরাসরি অভিযোগ দায়ের করুন। সেখান থেকে আপনাকে তাযাল্লুম মিন বালাগ তারকিল আমাল নামে একটি ফরম দেয়া হবে।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: The embassy warns that if you wait more than two months after learning of an absconding case, or really have run away, the Public Prosecution or court can send you home with a QR 12,000 fine or, if unpaid, a ban of up to 5 years; if the case is under one month old you can return without a fine.
quote: তাহলে আপনাকে পাবলিক প্রসিকিউশন বা আদালত দেশে যেতে বাধ্য করবে এবং ১২,০০০ রিয়াল জরিমানা অনাদায়ে ৫ বছরের জন্য কাতারে আপনাকে প্রয়োজনে নিষিদ্ধ করবে।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: A domestic worker who is abused should call Qatar's emergency number 999.
quote: নির্যাতনের স্বীকার হওয়া মাত্র কাতারের ইমার্জেন্সি হটলাইন নং ৯৯৯ এ যোগাযোগ করে পুলিশকে আপনার বিষয়ে বলুন।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: A worker who ran away from his company and is working outside can surrender at the 'Musallami Anfusahum' surrender section of the Search and Follow-up Department inside the CID with a valid passport and apply to go home; the officer says when he may return.
quote: আপনি বৈধ পাসপোর্ট নিয়ে কাতারের সিইআইডি’র ভিতরে অবস্থিত সার্চ এন্ড ফলোআপ ডিপার্টমেন্টের ‘মুসাল্লামি আনফুসাহুম’ সারেন্ডার সেকশনে গিয়ে নিজেকে আত্মসমর্পন পূর্বক দেশে যাওয়ার জন্য আবেদন করুন।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: If the passport has expired the embassy can extend it; if it is lost, file a general diary (GD) at a police station and apply to the embassy for a travel permit (TP) with its copy.
quote: আর পাসপোর্ট হারিয়ে গেলে থানায় জিডি করে তার কপিসহ টিপি (ট্যাভেল পারমিট) প্রাপ্তির জন্য দূতাবাসে আবেদন করতে হবে।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: Buying or selling visas and working on a 'free visa' are illegal in Qatar, punishable by 3 years in jail and a QR 50,000 fine, and a free-visa worker has no legal help if unpaid.
quote: ফ্রি ভিসাধারী অন্যত্র কাজ করার পর কোম্পানি বেতন-ভাতা ঠিকমতো পরিশোধ না করলেও আইনি সহায়তা নেয়ার কোনো সুযোগ থাকে না।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: To send a body home: collect from Hamad Hospital the notification of death, death certificate and the Human Services Office NOC, the company's documents, final settlement papers, the original passport and Qatar ID copy, the heirs' NIDs and the Bangladesh receiver's NID/passport copy and phone; submit them to the embassy labour wing for its NOC, then take the NOC to the Hamad mortuary.
quote: দূতাবাস হতে ইস্যুকৃত এনওসি নিয়ে হামাদ হাসপাতালের মর্গে যোগাযোগ করলে তারা লাশ দেশে পাঠানোর প্রয়োজনীয় প্রক্রিয়া সম্পন্ন করবে।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: For deaths outside hospital or in accidents, call the police on 999 first and get the police report.
quote: হাসপাতালের বাইরে অথবা দুর্ঘটনায় মারা গেলে প্রথমেই ৯৯৯ নং ফোন দিয়ে পুলিশকে জানাতে হবে এবং পুলিশ রিপোর্ট সংগ্রহ করতে হবে।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: For local burial in Qatar, the heirs give a no-objection letter and the documents go to the embassy labour wing for its NOC, which is taken to the hospital mortuary.
quote: উপর্যুক্ত ডকুমেন্টসমূহ নিয়ে দূতাবাসের শ্রম কল্যাণ উইংয়ে জমা প্রদানপূর্বক লাশ স্থানীয়ভাবে দাফনের জন্যে এনওসি সংগ্রহ করতে হবে।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: For accident-death compensation, the heirs' power of attorney must be attested by Bangladesh's Law and Foreign ministries, sent to the embassy, attested by Qatar's Foreign Ministry and a copy filed with the Public Prosecution in Qatar.
quote: দুর্ঘটনায় মৃত্যুজনিত ক্ষতিপূরণ প্রাপ্তির লক্ষ্যে মৃতের ওয়ারিশকর্তৃক প্রদত্ত পাওয়ার অব অ্যাটর্নি প্রস্তুতপূর্বক বাংলাদেশস্থ আইন মন্ত্রণালয় ও পররাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয় কর্তৃক যথাযথভাবে সত্যায়ন করে বাংলাদেশ দূতাবাস, কাতারে প্রেরণ করতে হবে।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

claim: The 2021 FAQ says WEWB membership is paid at the embassy counter at QR 170, open to migrants under 59; BMET-cleared workers are members automatically.
quote: দূতাবাসের কাউন্টারে ১৭০ রিয়াল জমা দিয়ে সহজেই সদস্যপদ গ্রহণ করতে পারেন।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links. Conflicts with the embassy's Nov 2025 WEWB page (QR 140).; re-check: conflict-settled (QR 170 (2021) is outdated; rule as above.)

claim: If a passport is lost, tell the employer, file a general diary (GD) at the nearest police station with an Arabic application signed by the employer, pay QR 10, and apply at the embassy with the GD, passport and Qatar ID copies; without the employer, apply to the Ambassador and the embassy writes to the police.
quote: জিডির ফি ১০ রিয়াল পরিশোধ করে পাসপোর্ট হারানোর জিডিপত্র সংগ্রহ করুন এবং জিডির কপি, পাসপোর্ট ও কাতার আইডির কপিসহ দূতাবাসে পাসপোর্ট রি-ইস্যুর জন্য আবেদন করুন।
note: BD Embassy Doha FAQ (Bangla), content last updated 1 Nov 2021; refers to pre-2021 ministry name (ADLSA) and old web links.

note: News report of MOL post; official page blocked.; re-check: still-lead -> R0001 (Portal steps are news only. Legal base: notify MOL, MOI updates the RP [R0001].)

note: News report of MOL post.; re-check: still-lead (MOL portal unreachable.)

claim: In January-March 2026 the Ministry's Labour Disputes Department registered 5,369 worker complaints against establishments and settled 2,797 within the quarter; the dispute committees received 1,190 cases and issued 2,228 decisions; inspectors found 651 WPS violations.
quote: The Labour Disputes Department registered 5,369 cases concerning workers’ complaints against establishments, of which 2,797 were successfully settled within the quarter.
note: News report of MOL statistics.

claim: In May 2026, 36 Nepali workers of one Qatari contractor reported eight months without pay; police told them to keep working, then to go home, and they took the case to the labour office in Sanaiya with a hearing pending.

note: News, May 2026.

claim: Human Rights Watch says the Wage Protection System and the Workers' Support and Insurance Fund have not been effective in preventing or resolving wage withholding.
quote: The rights organisation said mechanisms such as the Wage Protection System and the Workers’ Support and Insurance Fund had not been effective in preventing or resolving wage withholding.
note: News citing a Human Rights Watch report (Dec 2025).

claim: Their embassy advised the workers to give a power of attorney to legal representatives to continue the case, or to change employer.

note: NGO report, 2023.

claim: At one bank (QIB), a WPS salary account for workers earning up to QAR 5,000 is opened only when the employer starts the request on the bank's WPS portal; the worker needs a valid QID, a passport and a local mobile number, with no minimum balance and a free debit card.
quote: Worker must have a Valid QID and Passport
note: Bank's own product page (QIB); primary for this bank only; other banks not checked.

claim: QIB says its Payroll Package is for workers earning up to QAR 5,000 sponsored by a WPS-registered employer, which must start the account opening.

note: Bank's own product page (QIB).

claim: Qatar has abolished the exit permit for residents and the requirement for a no-objection certificate (NOC) to change employer.
