claim: The government says the NOC requirement is abolished, so employees can end their contracts without employer approval.
quote: Qatar has abolished the requirement for No-Objection Certificates, allowing employees to terminate their contracts without employer approval.
note: GCO In Focus page, modified 16 Mar 2026.

claim: The minimum wage of QAR 1,000 came into force in March 2021 for all sectors including domestic workers, plus QAR 500 for accommodation and QAR 300 for food unless provided in kind.

note: GCO In Focus page, modified 16 Mar 2026.

claim: The Workers' Support and Insurance Fund ensures workers receive their dues if their employer goes out of business or is forced to close.

note: GCO In Focus page, modified 16 Mar 2026.

claim: Grievance channels include a 24/7 hotline and 11 electronic complaint kiosks in 11 languages at 11 labour ministry branches.
quote: This includes a 24/7 hotline and 11 electronic complaint kiosks, operating in 11 languages. The kiosks are strategically located at 11 branches of the Ministry of Administrative Development, Labour and Social Affairs across Qatar.
note: GCO In Focus page, modified 16 Mar 2026.

claim: Domestic workers may leave Qatar without employer permission but must notify the employer at least 72 hours before departure.
quote: To maintain balance, domestic workers are required to notify their employers at least 72 hours before departure.
note: GCO In Focus page, modified 16 Mar 2026.

claim: The Labour Dispute Resolution Committees were set up in March 2018 to settle disputes within three weeks of a complaint.
quote: In March 2018, Qatar established Labour Dispute Resolution Committees to ensure that labour disputes are settled in a just and timely manner, within three weeks of filing a complaint.
note: GCO In Focus page, modified 16 Mar 2026.

claim: The National Human Rights Committee was established under Law No. 38 of 2002 to protect workers' rights.
quote: the country established the National Human Rights Committee under Law No. (38) of 2002 to protect workers’ rights

claim: Category 4: writers and researchers threatened for opinions expressed in newspapers, magazines or blogs.
quote: الكتاب والباحثون، الذين يعبرون عن آرائهم في الصحف والمجلات أو المدونات الإلكترونية

claim: Category 5: former or current government officials who oppose or have defected from their governments and fear prosecution.
quote: المسؤولون الحكوميون السابقون أو الحاليون المعارضون لحكوماتهم أو المنشقون عنها

claim: Under MOI Decision No. 38 of 2019, a person given an entry visa as an asylum seeker or refugee must complete the medical examination and fingerprints within fifteen days of entry.
quote: مراجعة الجهات المختصة لإنهاء إجراءات الفحص الطبي والبصمة خلال خمسة عشر يوماً من تاريخ دخوله البلاد.

claim: A recognised refugee's residence card is valid for two years and renewable.
quote: تكون مدة صلاحية بطاقة الإقامة سنتين، قابلة للتجديد لمدة أو مدد أخرى مماثلة.

claim: A holder of temporary residence as an asylum seeker must leave Qatar within sixty days of being notified that the asylum application was rejected.
quote: يجب على حامل تصريح الإقامة المؤقتة مغادرة البلاد خلال ستين يوماً من تاريخ إخطاره من اللجنة برفض طلب اللجوء السياسي.

claim: UNHCR's office in Qatar is in the UN House in Lusail, opened in March 2023, with 5 local and 4 international staff (March 2026).
quote: UNHCR’s office in Qatar is hosted inside the UN House in **Lusail,** offered by MOFA and inaugurated in March 2023.

claim: In December 2025 UNHCR and the Ministry of Interior signed an MoU to support developing national asylum procedures to implement the 2018 asylum law.
quote: The signed MoU formalises collaboration between UNHCR and MoI to support the development of national asylum procedures

claim: Decree No. 18 of 2026 ratified the MoU between the Ministry of Interior and the UNHCR office in Qatar signed in Doha on 7 December 2025.
quote: صُودق على مذكرة تفاهم بشأن التعاون وتبادل الخبرات بين وزارة الداخلية في دولة قطر ومكتب المفوضية السامية للأمم المتحدة لشؤون اللاجئين في دولة قطر

claim: Qatar is not listed as a party to the 1951 Refugee Convention in the UN Treaty Collection (the alphabetical list goes from Portugal to Republic of Korea).
quote: Portugal 3 22 Dec 1960 a Republic of Korea

claim: Human Rights Watch (2018) urged Qatar to accede to the 1951 Refugee Convention and its 1967 Protocol.
quote: Qatar should seal its commitment to refugee rights by acceding to the 1951 Refugee Convention and its 1967 Protocol

claim: Under Law No. 3 of 2016 every birth in Qatar must be reported to the competent authority.
quote: يجب تبليغ الجهة المختصة عن كل من يولد داخل الدولة

claim: The competent authority for births is the Ministry of Public Health's health offices that receive and register births and deaths.
quote: الجهة المختصة: مكاتب الصحة التابعة للوزارة والمختصة باستقبال وتسجيل واقعتي الولادة والوفاة.

claim: Births in Qatar must be reported within fifteen days.
quote: يجب التبليغ عن المواليد داخل الدولة خلال مدة لا تجاوز خمسة عشر يوماً من تاريخ الولادة

claim: Those required to report include the father if present, the doctor who delivered the baby and hospital directors, and the mother.
quote: مديرو المستشفيات العامة والخاصة والمؤسسات العقابية، وغيرها من الأماكن التي تتم فيها الولادة.

claim: A child's name may not be compound or against public order, and full siblings may not share one name.
quote: كما لا يجوز أن يكون الاسم مركباً أو مخالفاً للنظام العام.

claim: The parent goes to the competent Ministry of Interior department within seven days of the report to obtain the birth certificate; the first original is free.
quote: مراجعة الإدارة المختصة بوزارة الداخلية خلال سبعة أيام من تاريخ التبليغ لاستصدار واستلام شهادة الميلاد

claim: The first original birth certificate is handed to the parents free of charge.
quote: ويُسلم أصل الشهادة أول مرة دون مقابل، إلى والدي المولود أو من يقوم مقامهما.

claim: For a non-Qatari baby born in Qatar, the birth report must attach the parents' valid passports, their residence permits (or entry visas for non-residents) and the marriage contract attested by official authorities (if concluded abroad, certified by the official authorities).
quote: صورة عقد الزواج موثقاً من الجهات الرسمية داخل الدولة أو مُصدقاً عليه من الجهات الرسمية إذا كان العقد قد تم في الخارج.

claim: For a non-Qatari newborn, copies of both parents' valid passports are required.
quote: صورة جواز السفر ساري المفعول للوالدين، أو شهادة الوفاة لمن كان منهما متوفى.

claim: Since Law No. 1 of 2026, a child born outside marriage or of unknown father is registered on the basis of a decision of the competent court.
quote: يكون قيد الطفل غير الشرعي أو الطفل مجهول الأب ، بناءً على قرار المحكمة المختصة

claim: Qatari nationality by origin includes those born in Qatar or abroad to a Qatari father; nationality is not given for birth in Qatar to foreign parents.
quote: من ولد في قطر أو في الخارج لأب قطري بموجب البنود السابقة.
note: second half is the absence of any birthplace rule in Art 1; only foundlings born in Qatar are treated as naturalised (Art 2)

claim: Naturalisation needs at least 25 consecutive years of lawful residence in Qatar, among other conditions, and is by Amiri decision.
quote: أن يكون قد جعل، بطريق مشروع، إقامته العادية في قطر لمدة لا تقل عن خمس وعشرين سنة متتالية

claim: The Bangladesh Embassy in Doha registers the births of Bangladeshis born in Qatar (new birth certificates) and corrects certificates it issued.
quote: A Bangladeshi born in Qatar can be apply for new birth certificate.

claim: Embassy birth registration fees: free within 45 days of birth; QAR 10 within five years; QAR 10 within 10 years; correction QAR 13; re-print QAR 10 (non-refundable).
quote: Registration within 45 days-free of charge; Registration within five years-QAR 10.00; Registration within 10 years-QAR 10.00; Correction fee-QAR 13.00, Re-Print-QAR 10.00
value: Free within 45 days; QAR 10 within 5 or 10 years; correction QAR 13; re-print QAR 10

claim: Applications are received at the embassy counter 08:30-16:00 Sunday-Thursday; delivery 08:30-16:30 Sunday-Thursday.
quote: The application is received at the counter between 08:30 am to 04:00 pm (Sunday-Thursday)

claim: For a child born in Qatar, apply online at www.bdris.gov.bd under Birth Registration > Apply for birth registration.
quote: www.bdris.gov.bd ওয়েবসাইটে গিয়ে >>জন্ম নিবন্ধন>> জন্ম নিবন্ধন এর জন্য আবেদন করুন
note: transcribed from page image, p.1

claim: Upload the Qatar Ministry of Public Health birth certificate of the child and a copy of the father's passport; each file (pdf/jpg) at most 100 KB.

note: transcribed from page image, p.1

note: transcribed from page image, p.1

claim: Use a Bangladeshi mobile number and a personal email when submitting.

note: transcribed from page image, p.1

claim: Give the Qatar address as both place-of-birth address and present address.

note: transcribed from page image, p.1

claim: Print the form and submit at the embassy with the original Qatari MOPH birth certificate and a copy, copies of both parents' passports and Qatar IDs, and a white-background photo of the child.

note: transcribed from page image, p.1

claim: The embassy checks the application and documents and takes the applicable fee before processing.
quote: দূতাবাস কর্তৃপক্ষ আবেদনপত্র ও সংশ্লিষ্ট কাগজপত্র যাচাই পূর্বক প্রযোজ্য ফি গ্রহণ সাপেক্ষে পরবর্তী ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করবে।
note: transcribed from page image, p.1

note: transcribed from page image, p.1

claim: For corrections, proof of permanent address (citizenship certificate from Union Parishad chairman, mayor or ward councillor) must be notarised in Bangladesh, attested by the Law Ministry and Foreign Ministry, then attested by the embassy.
quote: প্রমাণপত্র বাংলাদেশে নোটারি পাবলিক করার পর বাংলাদেশের আইন মন্ত্রণালয় ও পররাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয় কর্তৃক সত্যায়নের পর দূতাবাসের সত্যায়নপূর্বক দাখিল করতে হবে
note: transcribed from page image, p.1

note: transcribed from page image, p.1

claim: The Registrar General's circular (posted by the embassy) says a name in birth registration must have at least two words (e.g. Sakhina Begum, not Sakhina), because one-word names cause passport problems abroad.

note: transcribed from page image, p.1

claim: The embassy says a newborn can apply for an e-passport with the Bangladeshi birth registration certificate and the Qatari birth certificate.

note: transcribed from page image, p.1

claim: Apply online at epassport.gov.bd and book an appointment (regular or express; express gets an earlier slot).
quote: অনলাইনে epassport.gov.bd ওয়েবসাইট এ প্রবেশ করে এবং আবেদন করে সুবিধাজনক সময়ে এপয়েন্টমেন্ট নিতে হয়।
note: transcribed from page image, p.1

claim: Missing the enrolment appointment cancels the application; a new application and appointment are then needed.
quote: তাহলে তার আবেদন বাতিল বলে গণ্য হবে।
note: transcribed from page image, p.1

quote: দূতাবাসে এনরোলমেন্টের জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় কাগজপত্র যেমনঃ জাতীয় পরিচয় পত্র, পাসপোর্ট, জন্ম নিবন্ধন সার্টিফিকেট ও কাতার আইডি নিয়ে আবেদনকারীকে সশরীরে উপস্থিত হতে হয়।

claim: The profession chosen must match the Qatar ID because the fee depends on it.

note: transcribed from page image, p.2

quote: e-Passport fees for Bangladesh Mission's Labors and Students: e-Passport with 48 pages and 5 years validity 1. Regular delivery : USD 30 2. Express delivery : USD 45

claim: Applicants under 18 submit the online birth registration certificate (English version).

claim: A minor without NID must give the father's or mother's NID number.
quote: অপ্রাপ্ত বয়স্ক (১৮ বছরের কম) আবেদনকারী যার জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্র (NID) নাই, তার পিতা অথবা মাতার জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্র (NID) নম্বর অবশ্যই উল্লেখ করতে হবে।

claim: Applicants under 6 must submit a 3R-size lab-print photo with a grey background.

claim: For a new passport applied for at a mission abroad, the permanent address column must show a contact address in Bangladesh.

claim: Residence regulations Art 3: to enter Qatar on any visa other than a residence visa, the travel document must be valid for at least six months from the date the entry visa is obtained; the authority may waive this when needed.
quote: ألا تقل مدة صلاحية مستند السفر لغير سمات الإقامة عن ستة أشهر من تاريخ الحصول على سمة الدخول، ويجوز للجهة المختصة التجاوز عن هذه المدة في الحالات التي تقتضي ذلك
value: 6 months from visa date (authority may waive)
note: MOI Decision 25/2019 (residence regulations), article not amended per Al Meezan; in force. Art 3(3). Explains V0096 (MOI 6 months) as the legal default; Hayya's 3 months (V0011) is a lower requirement the authority may allow under the waiver; QVC's 195 days (M0016) is QVC's appointment rule for residence/work visas, which are outside this 6-month rule.

claim: Residence regulations Art 13: entry visas are granted only if the holder's travel document is valid at least six months at issue; the Minister may add, delete or change visa types, their durations and extension rules from time to time.
quote: بشرط سريان مفعول صلاحية مستند سفر حاملها لمدة لا تقل عن ستة أشهر عند صدورها
note: MOI Decision 25/2019 (residence regulations), article not amended per Al Meezan; in force. Art 13.

claim: Residence regulations Art 30: tourist and business visit visas are valid for one trip of 30 or 60 days, or multiple entry for six months or one year with at most 90 days per trip.
quote: متعددة السفرات لمدة ستة أشهر، على أن تكون مدة الزيارة القصوى المسموحة في كل سفرة (90) يوماً
value: single entry 30 or 60 days; multiple entry 6 months or 1 year, max 90 days per trip
note: MOI Decision 25/2019 (residence regulations), article not amended per Al Meezan; in force. Art 30 (single entry: 'لسفرة واحدة لمدة (30) يوماً، أو (60) يوماً'). Higher rule than the MOI service pages on business visa length (V0085 1 month; V0093 90 days; V0072 1-6 months under 2007 decision).
